decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, so its results are uncertain, but it fits the firm's maritime customer base and long naval procurement cycles, and a large firm has the slack to carry it while results develop.

The medical examination light builds on the firm's institutional lighting expertise and has its own website page, so it uses existing capabilities at low cost and gives no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The explosion-proof industrial line extends a core competence for industrial and maritime users, is backed by certification investments and several models, and likely meets aspirations.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the established offer, has proven demand and low incremental cost, so management would keep it.
